seed.description: Same blueprint and seed, same monster

scale.description: Torso length in metres; every other length is a multiple of it

radius.description: Radius from the neck end to the tail end, in torso lengths

arch.description: Upward bow of the spine, as a share of torso length; negative sags

pitch.description: Degrees the torso tilts nose-up: 0 is horizontal, about 75 for an upright biped

torso.description: The main body. Its length is the blueprint `scale`.

length.description: Neck length in torso lengths; 0 for no neck

radius.description: Radius from the head end to the torso end, in torso lengths

pitch.description: Degrees the neck rises above horizontal

count.description: Necks, each with its own head shaped like body.head (a hydra has several)

spread.description: Degrees between the outermost necks as they fan out; default 25 per extra neck

curve.description: Degrees of S-bend: forward at the base and back below the head (a swan)

neck.description: Joins the head to the front of the torso.

length.description: Snout tip to back of skull, in torso lengths

jaw.description: A hinged lower jaw, needed for bite, roar and teeth

pitch.description: Degrees the snout points above horizontal

lips.description: Thickness of the lips along the mouth

brow.description: How heavy the brow ridge is

head.description: The head. `at` runs from the snout tip (0) to the back of the skull (1).

length.description: Tail length in torso lengths; 0 for no tail

radius.description: Radius from the root to the tip, in torso lengths

curl.description: Total degrees the tail bends upward along its length; negative curls down

curlStart.description: Share of the tail that stays straight before the curl begins; 0.6 curls only the end

pitch.description: Degrees the tail root points above horizontal; negative droops

count.description: Tails, each shaped like this one (a two-tailed fox has 2)

spread.description: Degrees between the outermost tails as they fan out; default 20 per extra tail

forkAt.description: Where along the tail several tails branch: 0 leaves the torso separately, 0.7 forks near the tip

tail.description: Runs back from the torso. `at` runs from the root (0) to the tip (1).

muscle.description: How muscled the body is, 0 (smooth tubes) to 1 (heavily built)

limbs.description: Legs and arms. Lists merge with the preset by id

id.description: Unique id; mirrored copies get .L and .R

on.description: Body section the limb grows from

at.description: Where along the section: 0 is the snout end, 1 the tail end

side.description: "both" makes a mirrored pair with ids ending .L and .R

angle.description: Degrees around the section from the top: 90 is the side, 180 the belly

length.description: Total limb length in torso lengths

segments.description: Bones from hip or shoulder to ankle

radius.description: Radius from root to tip, in torso lengths

muscle.description: How muscled this limb is, 0 to 1; left out, it follows body.muscle

remove.description: Delete an inherited limb with this id

splay.description: Degrees the limb swings out from under the body; about 50 for sprawlers

lift.description: Arms only: degrees the arm is raised forward from hanging; 90 holds it straight out (pincers)

stance.description: How the foot meets the ground: plantigrade (whole sole), digitigrade (toes), unguligrade (hoof tips); left out, the foot suggests one

foot.description: Foot or hand part at the limb tip (default { "type": "foot.claw" }); the id alone also works; null for none

anyOf.description: Foot part module; its parameters sit beside `type`

oneOf.description: A leg: carries the body; legs come in mirrored pairs

oneOf.description: An arm: hangs free, for grabbing and striking

role.description: "wing" limbs fold at rest and beat in the air

curl.description: Total degrees the tentacle curls at rest; negative curls the other way

curlStart.description: Share of the tentacle that stays straight before the curl begins

oneOf.description: A tentacle: a long tapering chain of up to 16 bones

items.description: A limb; its role decides its fields and defaults

parts.description: Hard parts. Lists merge with the preset by id

id.description: Unique id; mirrored copies get .L and .R

on.description: Body section (head, jaw, neck, torso, tail; spine runs neck to tail tip), limb id or part id

at.description: Where along it: snout-to-tail on sections, root-to-tip on limbs and parts

angle.description: Degrees around the section from the top: 0 dorsal, 90 side, 180 belly

side.description: Defaults to "both", or "center" when angle is 0 or 180

area.description: Area-slot parts only: which area of "on" they cover (back, belly, sides, all)

remove.description: Delete an inherited part with this id

base.description: Colour: "#rrggbb", "#rgb" or a CSS colour name

belly.description: Colour: "#rrggbb", "#rgb" or a CSS colour name

accent.description: Colour: "#rrggbb", "#rgb" or a CSS colour name

harmony.description: Generate the base, belly and accent you leave out from the seed: the accent analogous, complementary, triadic, split-complementary or the same hue (monochrome), around the base you give

additionalProperties.description: Colour: "#rrggbb", "#rgb" or a CSS colour name

palette.description: Named colours. base, belly and accent always exist; add any others by name

fur.description: Fur over the skin, where its region says; null removes an inherited coat

length.description: Hair length in torso lengths

region.description: Where it grows: a layer region or a list of them, e.g. ["torso", "limbs", "tail"]

anyOf.description: A coat of fur over the skin

id.description: Optional id; keys the layer random stream

items.description: One pattern layer; its parameters sit beside `type`

temperament.description: Sets pace, posture and idle behaviour

gaits.description: Gaits it may use; by default every gait that suits its body; a list replaces the defaults only for the media its gaits serve

actions.description: Actions it can perform; by default every action its body allows

media.description: Where it moves; each switch left out follows the body (land with legs, water with fins or tentacles and no legs, air with wings)

title: Spawnforge blueprint
description: A creature blueprint. Lengths are multiples of `scale` (torso length in metres). Module parameters are listed under $defs as "<kind>:<id>": part params go in a part's "params"; foot, layer, gait and action params sit beside "type".

part:antenna.description: A jointed antenna that sways on springs: thread-like, clubbed or feathery; side "both" for a pair.

length.description: Length in torso lengths

shape.description: "thread" plain, "club" thickened at the tip (a butterfly), "feather" combed (a moth)

curve.description: Degrees it curves back at rest

color.description: Colour: a palette name or a colour

part:armor.bands.description: Overlapping bands of armour across an area of the body, like an armadillo or a pangolin.

overlap.description: How much each band overlaps the next

scales.description: Break the bands into scales, like a pangolin

color.description: Armour colour: a palette name or a colour

part:beak.description: A horny beak in two halves, upper on the head and lower on the jaw, for birds and griffins.

shape.description: "hooked" like an eagle, "straight" like a heron, "broad" like a duck

length.description: Beak length relative to the snout

depth.description: How deep and heavy the beak is

color.description: Beak colour: a palette name or a colour

part:ear.pointed.description: Leaf-shaped ear, upright or drooping; use side "both" for a pair.

length.description: Length in torso lengths

thickness.description: Thickness as a share of the width: low is a flat leaf, 1 a round cone

curve.description: Degrees the ear bends; positive sweeps back toward the tail, negative forward

lean.description: Degrees the root tilts forward (+) or back (-)

droop.description: How much the ear flops outward and down, 0 upright to 1 hanging

color.description: Colour at the root: a palette name or a colour

part:eye.basic.description: Round eyeball with an iris and pupil that turns to look at targets and blinks.

irisColor.description: Iris colour: a palette name or a colour

scleraColor.description: Colour of the eyeball around the iris

iris.description: Iris size as a share of the visible eye

bulge.description: How far the eye stands out of the skin

part:fin.dorsal.description: One fin standing on the midline of the back (or belly, at angle 180), like a shark's.

length.description: Length along the body at its base

shape.description: "triangle" like a shark, "sail" tall and straight, "rounded" like a carp

color.description: Fin colour: a palette name or a colour

part:fin.tail.description: A tail fin at the tail tip: forked like a shark, rounded like a carp, or flat like a whale.

upper.description: Share of the fin above the tail line

color.description: Fin colour: a palette name or a colour

part:foot.claw.description: Foot or hand of short toes, each tipped with a curved claw; set it as a limb's "foot".

clawLength.description: Claw length in torso lengths; 0 for none

clawWidth.description: Claw thickness relative to the toe

clawColor.description: Claw colour: a palette name or a colour

part:foot.hoof.description: A hoof, single (a horse) or cloven (a goat or boar); set it as a leg's "foot".

cloven.description: Split into two toes, like a goat or a boar

size.description: Hoof size relative to the leg tip

height.description: How tall the hoof wall is

color.description: Hoof colour: a palette name or a colour

part:foot.pad.description: A broad column foot with blunt nails, for heavy creatures like elephants and trolls.

width.description: Foot width relative to the leg tip

nailColor.description: Nail colour: a palette name or a colour

part:foot.paw.description: A padded paw with toes and visible or hidden claws, like a dog or a big cat.

size.description: Paw size relative to the leg tip

claws.description: "hidden" like a cat at rest, "short" like a dog, "long" like a bear

padColor.description: Colour of the pads: a palette name or a colour

part:foot.talon.description: A bird-like foot: three long toes forward, one back, each with a hooked talon.

grip.description: How curled the toes are at rest

color.description: Scaly toe colour: a palette name or a colour

part:frill.description: A fan of spines with skin between them around the neck, folded at rest and opened in display.

radius.description: Frill radius when open, in torso lengths

open.description: How open it is at rest

color.description: Membrane colour: a palette name or a colour

part:hand.grasp.description: A grasping hand: fingers and an opposed thumb, with nails or claws; set it as "foot".

claws.description: Claw length in torso lengths; 0 for nails

clawColor.description: Claw or nail colour: a palette name or a colour

part:hand.pincer.description: A crab or scorpion pincer: a heavy claw with one hinged finger that snaps shut.

color.description: Claw colour: a palette name or a colour

part:hood.description: A cobra's hood: neck ribs that spread the skin into a flat shield in display.

width.description: Hood width when spread, in torso lengths

length.description: Share of the neck the hood covers

open.description: How spread it is at rest

markColor.description: Colour of the eye marks on the back of the hood

part:horn.curved.description: Tapered horn bent along an arc; use side "both" for a pair.

length.description: Length in torso lengths

curve.description: Total bend in degrees; positive sweeps back toward the tail, negative forward; past 360 it coils

twist.description: Spiral in degrees along the horn, like a ram

lean.description: Degrees the root tilts forward (+) or back (-)

turn.description: Degrees the bend turns sideways: 90 curves toward the midline (mandibles), -90 away from it

aim.description: Which way the horn points, wherever it sits: forward (mandibles, a bull), up, out (away from the body), back (swept back) or down (tusks). It replaces lean and turn

color.description: Colour at the root: a palette name or a colour

part:mandible.description: A pair of hinged mandibles or fangs at the mouth corners that close with the bite.

length.description: Mandible length in torso lengths

shape.description: "mandible" like an ant, "fang" like a spider's chelicerae

color.description: Colour: a palette name or a colour

part:membrane.bat.description: Leathery skin stretched between long finger bones, the body and the hind leg: bat and dragon wings.

span.description: Finger length relative to the arm: larger spreads a bigger wing

trailing.description: Where the trailing edge runs: to the nearest leg behind the wing, or to the body

scallop.description: How deeply the edge dips between fingers

color.description: Membrane colour: a palette name or a colour

part:membrane.case.description: A beetle's hard wing case (elytron): a shell that covers the same-side wing behind it and lifts in flight.

color.description: Case colour: a palette name or a colour

part:membrane.feather.description: Overlapping flight feathers along the wing bones, for birds and griffins.

length.description: Feather length relative to the wing bones: larger makes a broader wing

tips.description: Wing tip: rounded, pointed (a falcon) or fingered (an eagle)

color.description: Feather colour: a palette name or a colour

part:membrane.fin.description: A fin of thin rays with skin between them, on a fin limb (pectoral and pelvic fins).

width.description: Fin width relative to its length

color.description: Fin colour: a palette name or a colour

part:membrane.insect.description: A thin, veined insect wing on a hinge, for flies, dragonflies, moths and bees.

shape.description: "narrow" like a dragonfly, "broad" like a moth, "round" like a beetle

width.description: Wing width relative to its length

color.description: Wing colour: a palette name or a colour

part:plates.row.description: Upright bony plates along the back, in one row or two alternating rows like a stegosaur.

height.description: Height in torso lengths, as one number or a profile along the row

alternate.description: Two staggered rows, left and right

color.description: Plate colour: a palette name or a colour

part:quills.description: Long sharp quills scattered over an area of the body, raised in display, like a porcupine.

length.description: Quill length in torso lengths

lie.description: Degrees the quills lie back at rest

color.description: Quill colour: a palette name or a colour

part:sail.description: A tall sail of skin stretched over long spines along the back, like a dimetrodon.

height.description: Height in torso lengths, as one number or a profile along the sail

color.description: Membrane colour: a palette name or a colour

part:shell.description: A domed shell over an area of the body, divided into scutes, like a turtle or a tortoise.

dome.description: How domed: 0 flat, 1 a high tortoise shell

overhang.description: How far the rim reaches past the body

scutes.description: Plates on the shell; 0 for smooth

color.description: Shell colour: a palette name or a colour

seamColor.description: Colour of the seams between scutes

part:spikes.row.description: A row of conical spikes between two points, e.g. down the spine at angle 0.

height.description: Height in torso lengths, as one number or a profile along the row

curve.description: Degrees each spike sweeps back toward the tail

jitter.description: Irregular heights and angles, for jagged rows

color.description: Colour at the root: a palette name or a colour

part:teeth.row.description: Teeth along the mouth line; the upper row moves with the head, the lower with the jaw.

count.description: Teeth per row on each side

length.description: Tooth length in torso lengths

fangs.description: Long fangs at the front of each row

color.description: A palette name such as "accent", or a colour such as "#2a1e14"

pattern:bands.description: Wide, even rings of colour around the body and tail, like a coral snake or a lemur tail.

color.description: Band colour: a palette name or a colour

count.description: Bands from snout to tail tip

width.description: Band width as a share of the spacing

sharpness.description: How crisp the band edges are

pattern:bioluminescence.description: Glowing spots or lines that light up in the dark and pulse slowly.

color.description: Glow colour: a palette name or a colour

shape.description: "spots" scattered over the skin, or "lines" along the body

size.description: Spot radius or line width in torso lengths

density.description: Share of possible spots that glow

brightness.description: Emissive strength; 1 matches a lit surface

pattern:countershade.description: Paler belly blending into a darker back, as on most animals.

color.description: Belly colour: a palette name or a colour

height.description: Where the blend sits: -1 belly, 0 flank, 1 back

pattern:grime.description: Dirt gathered in creases, on the feet and low on the body; adds roughness.

color.description: A palette name such as "accent", or a colour such as "#2a1e14"

feet.description: Dirt rising from the ground up the legs

pattern:mottle.description: Soft, cloudy blotches of a second colour that break up the outline.

color.description: A palette name such as "accent", or a colour such as "#2a1e14"

contrast.description: How sharp the blotch edges are

pattern:rosettes.description: Leopard-like rosettes: broken rings of dark marks around a tinted centre.

color.description: Ring colour: a palette name or a colour

density.description: Share of possible rosettes that appear

broken.description: How broken each ring is into separate marks

pattern:scales.description: Overlapping scales as bump and darker gaps between them.

gapColor.description: Colour in the gaps between scales: a palette name or a colour

gap.description: How dark and wide the gaps are

pattern:scars.description: Old healed scars: pale, raised streaks and claw rakes across the skin.

color.description: Scar colour: a palette name or a colour

count.description: How many scars over the body

length.description: Scar length in torso lengths

rake.description: Parallel cuts per scar: 3 or 4 read as claw marks

depth.description: How raised and creased the scars are

pattern:slime.description: A wet, glossy coat of slime with drips and a faint tint.

color.description: Slime tint: a palette name or a colour

wetness.description: How glossy the skin gets (1 is mirror-wet)

drips.description: How many drips run down the flanks

tint.description: How much the slime colours the skin

pattern:spots.description: Scattered round spots, from leopard rosettes to sparse blotches.

color.description: A palette name such as "accent", or a colour such as "#2a1e14"

density.description: Share of possible spots that appear

pattern:stripes.description: Bands running across the spine (or along it), with optional wobble.

color.description: A palette name such as "accent", or a colour such as "#2a1e14"

count.description: Stripes from snout to tail tip

width.description: Stripe width as a share of the spacing

direction.description: "across" the spine like a tiger, or "along" it

fade.description: How much stripes fade toward the belly

pattern:veins.description: Branching veins under thin skin, darker or glowing.

color.description: Vein colour: a palette name or a colour

raised.description: How far the veins stand out

pattern:warts.description: Raised bumps and warts, like a toad or a troll.

color.description: Wart colour: a palette name or a colour

density.description: Share of possible warts that appear

height.description: How far the warts stand out

gait:bound.description: Small quadrupeds leaping with both hind legs, then both front legs, like a rabbit or a weasel.

flex.description: How much the spine flexes each bound

gait:fly.description: Flapping flight: power strokes on the way down, wings folded on the way up.

bank.description: Most degrees it banks into a turn

gait:gallop.description: Fast four-legged gait with a leading leg and a moment in the air, like a horse.

style.description: "transverse" like a horse, "rotary" like a cheetah or a dog

flex.description: How much the spine flexes each stride

gait:glide.description: Soaring and gliding on spread wings between flaps.

sink.description: How fast it loses height while gliding

gait:hover.description: Hovering in place on fast figure-eight wingbeats, like an insect or a hummingbird.

gait:run.description: Two-legged running with a moment in the air each stride, for raptors and runners.

duty.description: Share of the cycle each foot is planted

lean.description: Degrees the body leans forward at speed

gait:slither.description: Legless travelling wave down the spine; each segment follows the path of the one ahead.

amplitude.description: Sideways swing as a share of body length

gait:swim.flap.description: Swims by beating fins or flippers like wings, like a turtle or a penguin.

gait:swim.paddle.description: Swims at the surface by paddling its legs, like a dog or a bear.

gait:swim.undulate.description: Swims with a body wave that grows toward the tail, like a fish, an eel or a crocodile.

amplitude.description: Tail-beat width as a share of body length

gait:tripod.description: Six-legged insect gait: two alternating tripods of feet.

duty.description: Share of the cycle each foot is planted

stepHeight.description: Foot lift as a share of hip height

gait:trot.description: Faster four-legged gait: diagonal feet move together.

duty.description: Share of the cycle each foot is planted

stepHeight.description: Foot lift as a share of hip height

gait:walk.description: Slow gait for any leg count: feet lift one after another, back to front.

duty.description: Share of the cycle each foot is planted; defaults by leg count

stepHeight.description: Foot lift as a share of hip height

action:bite.description: Lunges the head at a target and snaps the jaw shut; fires a bite-contact event.

reach.description: How far the neck may stretch, as a share of its reach

action:display.description: Threat display: opens frills and hoods, raises quills and sails, spreads wings.

duration.description: Seconds for a creature with 1 m hips; scales with size

action:idle.description: Breathing, weight shifts, glances, tail swish and blinks while standing.

fidget.description: How often it shifts and looks around

action:jump.description: Crouches, leaps to a target point or over a height and lands on its legs; fires takeoff and land events.

action:lash.description: Whips the tail or a tentacle at a target; fires a lash-contact event.

action:look.description: Turns eyes, head and neck toward a target within limits.

range.description: Degrees the head may turn from straight ahead

action:pinch.description: Snaps a pincer shut on a target; fires a pinch-contact event.

action:pounce.description: A jump that ends in a bite on the target; fires takeoff, land and bite-contact events.

reach.description: How far the head lunges at the end

action:roar.description: Raises the head and opens the jaw wide; fires a roar-peak event.

duration.description: Seconds for a creature with 1 m hips; scales with size

intensity.description: How wide the jaw opens and how far the head rises

theme:demon.description: Horned fiends and hellhounds: heavy shoulders, big curled or swept horns, fangs, spine rows, goat or slit pupils, blood reds and soot blacks.

theme:insect.description: Six-legged beetles and ants: glossy chitin, a thorax and abdomen with a narrow waist, thin legs, horns or pincers, dark or warning colours.

theme:reptile.description: Scaled lizards, raptors and snakes: low sprawling bodies, long tails, wedge or snout heads, slit pupils, greens and browns.

stats:rpg.description: Generic action-RPG numbers: health from mass, speed from legs and gaits, attack from teeth, horns and claws, defence from chitin, scales and spikes, perception from eyes and ears.

level.description: Multiplies health, attack and defence (unitless; 1 is a normal encounter)
